unsupported: Ball Packaging Products, operating as Ball Corporation, is headquartered in Westminster, Colorado.

Ball serves the beverage packaging industry, supplying cans for beer, water, soda, and other drinks, as well as aluminum bottles for sporting events and concert venues. It also provides aerosol packaging for personal care and household brands. Customers range from global beverage brands to regional bottlers.
The company states that its global scale and sustainability focus differentiate it in the market.
